proposed_rules.trigger: A case-study page whose entire body after the title collapses into a single very tall node (>3000px) with only concatenated text and no distinguishable pull-quotes, stat callouts, or images.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction to recover embedded rich content (quotes, stats, images) rather than concluding the case study is one plain-text block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The visual-tree capture/pruning flattens nested rich content in long-form case studies into a single text blob, the same failure mode as underrendered-list-zone but for article bodies rather than card grids.
